RaceCatalog.intro: Catalog of competitive events, editions and courses.
RaceCatalog.emptyEvents: No events match this search. You can create the first one.
RaceCatalog.emptyEditions: This event has no editions yet.
RaceCatalog.emptyCourses: This edition has no courses yet.
RaceCatalog.archiveNotice: This record will no longer be available for new selections. Its references and data already saved in goals or plans will be preserved. Archiving an edition also prevents selecting its courses.
RaceCatalog.snapshotNotice: Selection saves a copy of the course data. Later catalog changes will not modify goals or plans already saved.
RaceCatalog.unknownHint: Leave distance or elevation gain blank when unknown. An elevation gain of 0 is a known value, not missing data.
RaceCatalog.derivedHint: Course descriptors calculated from distance and elevation gain. They do not represent training load.
RaceCatalog.emptySelection: No selectable courses found. Selection requires an active event, published edition and course, and known distance.
RaceCatalog.searchLimit: Up to 50 results are shown. Refine the search by event, edition or course.
RaceCatalog.planNotice: A planned competition will be created for this group or cohort. The plan's historical target is not automatically replaced.
